sentences.text: In Mainz-Bingen there are 593 reports over ten years, with main time February to October.
The conservation status is listed as data deficient (DD) on the IUCN Red List.
It belongs to the group Insect or spider, class Insecta, order Hymenoptera.
It has been recorded eating Bull Thistle, Garden cosmos, Borage and common dandelion.
Recorded as predators are Asian hornet, Goldenrod Crab Spider, Shiny crab-spider and European beewolf.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Phacelia, False London-rocket, Scentless Mayweed and Alpine Squill.
